title: Named capabilities (S7 first values, P9)
note: Flat registry of capability ids an Intent may request (001 Intent taxonomy). Each id must have exactly one entry in grant-mappings.json; the compiler rejects any id not registered here. Harness/model selection adds no implicit capability (AUTH-009).

capabilities.description: Invoke the Anthropic API under the project's reviewed OneCLI credential.
Invoke the OpenAI/Codex API under the project's reviewed OneCLI credential.
Read-only GitHub access (clone/pull, list/read repos, issues, pull requests) via the reviewed GitHub App connection. No approval needed per call.
Mutating GitHub access (push, create pull requests/issues/comments, delete branches) via the reviewed GitHub App connection. Every call requires approval.
